messages:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert triggered for service `inference-gateway` (P1) — 502 error-rate spike in region us-west1. Alert URL: https://pd.example/alerts/PD12345 :rotating_light:
oncall-maya: acked. I'm on it, jumping in to triage now.
lucas: seeing a ~12% 502 rate from edge -> auth-proxy. Started ~11:50 UTC. Any recent deploys?
deploybot: Deploy event: auth-proxy v2.1.1 deployed to us-west1 at 2024-11-13T11:48:20Z by lucas.
oncall-maya: thanks — running quick checks. curl from a worker to origin health returns 200. curl via edge -> 502. Quick snippet:```bash
curl -sI -H 'Host: api.example.com' https://edge-usw1.internal/health 
# -> HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
```
sre-john: can you attach a short sample from the edge logs (request id) so we can trace upstream?
lucas: pasted below: `req=usw1-req-9a7f` stack shows auth-proxy returning 502 with "upstream prematurely closed" on chunked requests.
oncall-maya: traffic patterns: only clients with Transfer-Encoding: chunked seem to hit it. Rate looks concentrated to a few IP ranges (mobile edge).
sre-john: recommendation: rollback auth-proxy to v2.1.0 while we root-cause. Rolling back will remove the regression.
lucas: initiating rollback to v2.1.0 — starting now.
deploybot: Rollback started for auth-proxy in us-west1 (deploy id rollback-181818). Pods terminating & new pods with v2.1.0 created.
oncall-maya: after rollback, 502s dropping — current 502 rate 1.8% (was 12%). Monitoring for 10m. :thumbsup:
support-ash: chime in on customer impact — CS reported 5 distinct customer error tickets in the last 15m (IDs: CS-4421, CS-4423, CS-4425). None escalated to enterprise so far.
oncall-maya: posting incident note to status page: "Partial 502 errors for subset of requests via auth-proxy; rollback applied, monitoring." https://status.example/incidents/INF-502-2024
sre-john: next steps: file bug for chunked encoding header handling, add unit/regression test, and backfill canary checks to catch this pattern.
lucas: created INF-542 (auth-proxy chunked request regression) and assigned to eng-proxy. https://tracker.example/INF-542
oncall-maya: will keep watch. If stable for 30m we'll resolve the pager. Adding postmortem owners: lucas + john.
incident-bot: PagerDuty incident PD12345 acknowledged by oncall-maya.
oncall-maya: closing check-in at 30m: current 502 rate steady at ~0.9%, support queue quieting. I'll open a postmortem draft and ping CX.
sre-john: thanks all — please add any follow-ups to INF-542.
oncall-maya: thanks team, closing in 10m if no regression. :white_check_mark:
